subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

They were not surprised by the results and nor __were__ I.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'was.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the past tense and** I** take a singular verb** 'was' **in the past tense.

 
 
• **Example**: *I was there with him.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'were' should be replaced by 'was' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Correct sentence__:* They were not surprised by the results and nor **was** I.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Countable nouns, as the term suggests, refer to things that can be counted.
 
• They have singular and plural forms.
 
 
• Example: *table, tables; month, months; pen, pens.*
 
 
 
• Uncountable nouns cannot be counted.
 
• They have a singular form and do not have a plural form.
 
 
• Example: *dirt, rice, information, furniture, and hair.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

 
• दिया गया वाक्य भूतकाल में है और **I** भूत काल में एकवचन क्रिया 'was' लेता हैं।

 
 
• Example: *I was there with him.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए वाक्य में 'were' के प्रयोग को 'was' से बदल देना चाहिए ताकि वह व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही हो।​
